our_interpretation: The article identifies its historical dataset as January 2024 through September 2025. That is the target period.
The checkable content is the claimed absence of demonstrated cost reductions and the direction of monthly burn, not the speaker's private mental state.
The ordinary financial meaning of burn is net cash consumption. Monthly AWS payments are only one component and cannot be substituted for total burn.
A documented cost reduction or decline in monthly net cash burn would challenge the categorical wording. A single AWS billing decline does not establish either company-wide result.
The source does not specify an accounting basis for monthly burn.
criteria.support_condition: Complete, comparable records for the target period show rising monthly net cash burn and no demonstrated cost reductions supporting the claimed absence of cost-cutting success.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matched records show a decline in monthly net cash burn or a demonstrated cost reduction within the target period. A literal claim that AWS spending never fell can separately be tested against the AWS series.
